description: This source file defines the RemindersService class, which implements functionality to list and add reminders using EventKit framework. It includes methods for fetching reminders with filtering options, adding new reminders with optional due dates and notes, and resolving reminder lists by ID or name.

classes.name: RemindersService
classes.description: Final class that provides asynchronous methods for listing and adding reminders using EventKit.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Fetches a list of reminders based on parameters, filtering by status and limiting number of results.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new reminder with specified title, notes, due date, and list, returning the created reminder payload.

methods.name: resolveList
methods.description: Resolves a reminder list (calendar) either by ID, name, or default list fallback.
